my_own_diagnosis: From xbase + focal alone: the strictly bottom-up progression from oldest to newest leaves is the diagnostic signature of a mobile-nutrient deficiency (nitrogen, with magnesium as a close differential); the iron/alkaline-soil pathway is immediately excluded because iron is immobile and its deficiency always presents first on the youngest upper leaves as interveinal chlorosis, not on old lower leaves.
focal_notes: The focal feature identifies both the correct direction (mobile-nutrient/nitrogen bottom-up pattern) and the exclusion rule (immobile nutrients present top-down), giving a competent practitioner everything needed to reject the distractor without ambiguity.
oracle_notes: HL/LL cell_oracles correctly carry the low_diagnostic_oracle_focus text and HH/LH correctly carry the focal oracle_focus text; the low_diagnostic oracle appropriately defers without adopting the distractor.
